title: Enterprise Connectivity: acceptance export volume
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this acceptance export volume rule to invoice ceiling acceptance.

## Basis: volume
For invoice ceiling acceptance, read the posted primary internet outbound transfer volume for the exact selected export bundle identifier and its source billing month; cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded.

## Basis Q&A
| Invoice ceiling acceptance basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice ceiling acceptance: Read the posted primary internet outbound transfer volume for the exact selected export bundle identifier and its source billing month | cancelled records, other source bundles, other meters and other periods are excluded. |

## Hypothetical export selection
For a hypothetical invoice ceiling acceptance, a posted primary internet outbound export naming the selected bundle and its billing month contributes its measured volume. A cancelled export or an export for another bundle contributes none, even if it is recorded in the same month.
